node.statement: By def-invisible-mass and the halo-robust sigma_g definition in the contract, sigma is the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>0 and sigma_g is the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>tau/4. With G={H_j>tau/4}, B={0<H_j<=tau/4}, and Z={H_j=0}, this gives sigma=sum_{G union B}a_j^+, sigma_g=sum_G a_j^+, sigma_g<=sigma, sigma-sigma_g=sum_B a_j^+, and sum_{j notin G}a_j^+-sum_j a_j^-=1-sigma_g by node 1.1.1.
